en.title: Road Trip
en.description:
Given the distance from the start of each city's gas station along a straight route, output the distance from the start to the first station and then between each pair of subsequent adjacent stations.

The input protocol was prepared by this site; the count and distance ranges of Road Trip are explicit supplements by this site and do not represent limits of the original problem.
en.input: One line containing 1..5000 items of the form `city name, distance`, separated by semicolons, possibly with a trailing semicolon. City names are non-empty and contain no commas or semicolons; distances are integers in 0..1000000000.
en.output: After sorting by distance from the start in ascending order, output the distance from the start to the first station and the distances between adjacent stations, separated by an ASCII comma and a space; stations at the same position are 0 apart.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First turn the textual rules into explicit states, then verify the boundaries independently.
